name: Mithril
description:
This modifications adds a new resource to the game.

Mithril is a magical metal worth 1,000 gold per unit.

- Mithril Mine produces 1 unit of mithril per day for its owner.
- Warehouse of Mithril provides 6-10 mithril once per week and refills after 7 days.

Currently, Mithril mine can appear on random maps using the Coldshadow's Fantasy template only.
author: George King
